venue.title: Hire Our Amazing Function Room
venue.text: Our main hall is an amazing space — beautifully set up for up to 200 guests with dance floor, big screen, stage, licensed bar and free parking. As you can see from the photos, it works perfectly for weddings, birthdays, parties, wakes, live music and community group gatherings. We can also provide catering — food and drinks packages to suit your event. Get in touch for availability and costs.
